layer_contracts.name: foundational substrate
layer_contracts.purpose: Register the physical artifacts and actor-artifact relations on which every higher layer depends.

deliverable.authority: Compiled projection of registered membership, relation claims, population boundary, and residue; never an authored source.

required_sections.semantic_dimension: one actor-artifact relation per identity pair
authorship mutation temporal and authority axes
enumerated definitional choices or explicit unknown
structured store grain key and failure-mode declarations for every part

layer_contracts.name: entity spine
layer_contracts.purpose: Resolve every in-scope reference to a durable identity for every entity, with explicit roll-ups and failure discrimination.

deliverable.authority: Canonical entity ids, source-space mappings, declared grain, roll-ups, ambiguity, and unresolved residue for the pinned run.

required_sections.semantic_dimension: per-space numerator denominator and explicit exclusions

layer_contracts.name: multi-view affinity
layer_contracts.purpose: Emit raw per-view evidence when sources are available, then normalize discriminating affinity matrices over one L1 entity population while preserving missingness as missing rather than zero.

deliverable.authority: Per-view affinity evidence, discrimination receipts, entity ordering, missingness, and coverage; no fusion or identity authority.

required_sections.semantic_dimension: source-native structure and behavior evidence available before L1
common L1 identity and grain vintage
structure flow behavior or semantic view definition
per-view ability to produce a different result

layer_contracts.name: fusion
layer_contracts.purpose: Fuse two or more independently discriminating views and demonstrate stable structure across controlled runs.

deliverable.authority: Fusion results, run ensemble, stability, benchmark comparison, membership model, and residue; no durable identity minting.

layer_contracts.name: identity and succession
layer_contracts.purpose: Mint stable identities once, recompute membership, match signatures, and record birth death split and merge as first-class events.

deliverable.authority: Minted identity ids, signatures, memberships, matches, and append-only succession events.

required_sections.semantic_dimension: new signature to prior signature comparison
birth death split or merge event
same code across workspace portal and knowledge planes
